name: Dart SDK
description: Installs the Dart SDK from the official Dart archive (stable channel), with SHA-256 verification. Local feature: there is no maintained Dart feature in the devcontainers organization.

version.description: Dart SDK version from the stable channel: a major (3) or major.minor (3.14) for the newest release within it, an exact version (3.14.1), or 'latest'.
